name: selfportrait-studio-backend
description: Self-Portrait Studio — Express + Sequelize API (MySQL local / PostgreSQL production)

scripts.db:check: node -e "require('./config/database').authenticate().then(() => { console.log('DB connection OK'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:sync:safe: node -e "require('./models').sync().then(() => { console.log('DB synced safely'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.db:reset:danger: node -e "require('./models').sync({ force: true }).then(() => { console.log('DB synced'); process.exit(); })"
